title: Amillennialism 101 (audio lecture series)
author: Kim Riddlebarger
summary: An introductory Reformed lecture series presenting amillennialism: Christ's present heavenly reign as the millennium, the binding of Satan at the first advent, and a single consummation at the Second Coming.

title: PostmillennialWorldview: articles tagged 'hyper-preterism'
author: Kenneth L. Gentry Jr.
summary: A partial preterist's series of critiques of full preterism, arguing that a future bodily resurrection and Second Coming remain unfulfilled.

title: Eschatology.org (Don K. Preston's teaching ministry)
author: Don K. Preston
summary: Teaching site of a leading 'covenant eschatology' (full preterist) author, arguing that all biblical prophecy, including the resurrection, was fulfilled by AD 70.
